title: Equidistribution of currents under Anosov group actions
summary: We study the behavior of currents on flag-manifolds under actions of Anosov subgroups of complex semisimple Lie groups G. Given a current T of bidimension (k, k) on the full flag-manifold F = G/B, we average it under the group action via a construction analogous to the construction of Patterson-Sullivan measures.
